description: Elections Commission - Parliamentary Election - 2024 Appointed the Assistant Returning Officers.
categorisation: This gazette content is a notice under Section 6(1) of the Parliamentary Elections Act, 1981, appointing Assistant Returning Officers for electoral districts. It specifically relates to electoral processes and contains the designation "PARLIAMENTARY ELECTION - 2024" at the beginning. The content involves election administration through the appointment of election officials across various electoral districts, which falls squarely under the Elections category (Type 7) for electoral processes and related matters.
